style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 15m Pre Lit Eucalyptus  White Berry Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Combining cosiness and drama, our Pre Lit Eucalyptus and White Berry Christmas Garland is sure to become a staple of your seasonal decorating. A natural twig base supports a 1.5m length of winter faux foliage including delicate eucalyptus leaves, interwoven with cheerful sprays of mistletoe berries. </p><p>A set of warm white micro LEDs, set on a silver wire, are wound through the greenery to give the garland a beautiful sparkle. Run this decoration along a mantlepiece over the stockings with a wreath above it, or arrange it as a table runner on a snowy white tablecloth. </p><p>To illuminate, simply insert 3 x AA batteries into the attached box and switch to ‘on.’ Use the 6 hour timer for automatic illumination at the same time each evening. </p><p>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.&nbsp;</p><ul><li>(L) 1.5m&nbsp;<br></li><li>Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)&nbsp;<br></li><li>Optional 6 hour timer function&nbsp;</li><li>Size : ONE</li></ul>
